sentence: This project studies how two proteins help a type of cell develop and how they affect inflammatory bowel diseases.
This project builds a shared infrastructure for cancer research and carries out pilot projects to gather preliminary data.
This project builds a research center that studies health disparities between racial and ethnic groups.
This project tries to create a blood test that predicts whether cancer immunotherapy will work, and tests adding a second medication.
This project studies how one transcription factor decides whether synovial fibroblasts cause inflammation or invade cartilage and bone.
This project tries to find out which epigenetic mechanisms lower the levels of one gene in scleroderma lung fibroblasts.
This project builds a three-dimensional map of ovarian cancer using tumor tissue samples from primary and metastatic sites.
This project studies how a group of transcription factors affect two signaling pathways in stem cells from glioblastoma multiforme and myoblasts.
This project builds a course and seminar series on biofabrication, which merges materials science processing with controlled cellular behavior.
This project builds a method that extracts membrane proteins together with nearby proteins and lipids to study how they are regulated and activated.
This project looks for better ways of detecting stomach cancer in its earliest stages.
This project builds a computational method that combines imaging, genomic data and biomechanical modeling to study how chronic obstructive pulmonary disease progresses.
This project builds personalized nanovaccines coated with tumor cell membranes that aim to trigger T cell immunity against solid tumors and metastatic lesions.
This project builds partnerships with the community to reduce the burden of cancer and cancer health disparities across the state.
This project studies how HIV hijacks host factors to reach transcription sites, bind viral RNA and produce infectious virus particles.
This project builds and tests base editing and prime editing to correct common gene mutations in familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in vivo.
This project builds mass spectrometry methods to study neuropeptides and biogenic amines that help control feeding.
This project tests hybrid biological-abiotic catalysts for proximity labeling to find which proteins sit in specific places inside neurons.
This project provides support in biostatistics, bioinformatics and data management for researchers who study environmental health.
This project makes viral vectors at scale and guides gene editing treatments along the regulatory path toward a clinical trial.
